subject: general
question:
Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, M, N and O, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

Only three boxes are kept below D. Only two boxes are kept between D and O. Only A is kept above M. C is kept at some place below B and at some place above N. Which box is kept at the second position from the bottom?
solution:
Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, M, N and O, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only three boxes are kept below D.
 
• Only two boxes are kept between D and O.
 
• Only A is kept above M.
 
• C is kept at some place below B and at some place above N

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 

 
 
M

 
 
 

 
 
B

 
 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
N

 
 
 

 
 
O

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
